name: Weights & Biases Weave
description: W&B's agent tracing and evaluation toolkit, SDK under Apache-2.0.
descriptionZh: W&B 的 Agent 追踪与评测工具包，SDK 为 Apache-2.0。
keyFact: Weave is Weights & Biases' Apache-2.0 toolkit for tracing and evaluating AI agents, offering guardrails, a playground and leaderboards; W&B itself has been acquired by CoreWeave, and a self-hosted W&B Server is published separately.
keyFactZh: Weave 是 Weights & Biases 以 Apache-2.0 开源的 AI Agent 追踪与评测工具包，提供 guardrails、playground 与 leaderboards；W&B 已被 CoreWeave 收购，另有单独发布的自托管 W&B Server。
